---
title: "支援4月"
author: "yuiy"
date: "2026-04-05"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)


path <- "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣公車.csv"
data <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


date1 <- ymd(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
data$year <- year(date1)
data$month <- month(date1)


data_use <- data %>%
  filter(year == 2025, month %in% 1:6)


month_table <- table(data_use$month)


all_months <- 1:6
month_table <- month_table[as.character(all_months)]
month_table[is.na(month_table)] <- 0

ride_count <- as.numeric(month_table)


x_labels <- paste0("114", sprintf("%02d", all_months))


png(
  filename = "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/114年1月至114年6月臺東縣市區客運運量折線圖.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

windowsFonts(kai = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))

par(
  family = "kai",
  mar = c(5,7,6,2),
  mgp = c(4.1,1,0)  
)

plot(
  x = all_months,
  y = ride_count,
  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "black",
  xlab = "月份",
  ylab = "搭乘次數",
  ylim = c(0, max(ride_count)*1.3),
  xaxt = "n",
  yaxt = "n",
  bty = "n",
  cex.lab = 1.8 
)


title(
  main = "114年1月至114年6月臺東縣市區客運運量折線圖",
  adj = 0,
  cex.main = 1.8
)


axis(
  1,
  at = all_months,
  labels = x_labels,
  cex.axis = 1.2
  )


axis(
  2,
  at = pretty(c(0, max(ride_count))),
  las = 1,
  cex.axis = 1.2
)



grid()


dev.off()
```
